ephemeris_modeling.description: Uncertainty in lunar and planetary ephemeris fitting, derived from scatter of eta across INPOP19a and DE430

atmospheric_delay.description: Tropospheric delay correction uncertainties: seasonal model projected onto cos(elongation). Only correlated component counts.
atmospheric_delay.reference: Data-driven from monthly mean residual variation, elongation-correlated projection

instrumental.description: Detector calibration and timing electronics: station-bias model projected onto cos(elongation).
instrumental.reference: Data-driven from powered-station mean residual variation, elongation-correlated projection

tidal_modeling.description: Solid Earth and ocean tide model uncertainties: cos(2*elongation) harmonic projected onto cos(elongation). Orthogonal component excluded.
tidal_modeling.reference: Data-driven from 2nd-synodic-harmonic residual amplitude, elongation-correlated projection

thermal_expansion.description: Telescope and retroreflector thermal expansion: diurnal model projected onto cos(elongation). Orthogonal component excluded.
thermal_expansion.reference: Data-driven from diurnal residual variation, elongation-correlated projection

unexplained.description: Residual variance not accounted for by known systematics
